findings.evidence: Lines 97–103 contain `(Measure.map f (P : Measure α)) s`; the existing `probabilityMeasureCode_apply` and `ProbabilityMeasure.toMeasure_map` reduce the proposed abstract statement to this equality.
findings.fix: State the left side as `probabilityMeasureCode (P.map f) s`, retaining the current preimage right side and `@[simp]`.
findings.issue: `probabilityMeasureCode_map_apply` does not mention `probabilityMeasureCode`; its left side is raw `Measure.map`, making the advertised code API indirect and misleading.

findings.evidence: Lines 137–139 use `P.map fun x j => x (i * (n * m) + j)`, while lines 142–145 reconstruct the abstract `blockMarginals` statement internally as `hOld`.
findings.fix: Restore the left side to `(P.blockMarginals (n * m) i).map (blockRestriction …)`; add a separately named concrete-coordinate lemma only if that representation is independently required.
findings.issue: `map_blockRestriction_blockMarginals_mul` no longer mentions the large `blockMarginals` object named by the theorem and instead exposes its coordinate-map implementation, weakening the abstraction boundary for downstream rewriting.

summary: Two new public lemmas expose implementation-level measure expressions instead of characterizing the named coded and block-marginal abstractions.
